public_api_mapping.name: readComments
public_api_mapping.signature: readComments(input: BinaryInput, options: { selection?: SelectionQuery; id?: string }, context: SelectionContext): Promise<readonly CommentRecord[]>
public_api_mapping.default_behavior: Empty read options enumerate all slide comments without creating parts; missing result is empty array.
public_api_mapping.side_effects: None; supplied input capabilities may read bytes.

public_api_mapping.name: mutateComments
public_api_mapping.signature: mutateComments(input: BinaryInput, action: "add" | "set" | "remove", options: MutateCommentsOptions, context: SelectionContext): Promise<{ bytes: Uint8Array; affected: number; locations: readonly Location[] }>
public_api_mapping.default_behavior: Add requires explicit author/text/timestamp and defaults position to origin. Set leaves omitted fields untouched. Mutations require one selected comment unless all is explicit; empty mutation fails unless allowEmpty.
public_api_mapping.side_effects: Returns edited bytes; does not publish or consult ambient host capabilities.

public_api_mapping.name: CommentRecord
public_api_mapping.signature: Readonly record { id: string; selector: string; location: Location; slide: number; part: string; authorId: string; index: number; author: string; initials: string; text: string; timestamp: string; left: number; top: number }
public_api_mapping.ownership: Detached values; slide ordinal one-based, location coordinateSystem identity; id authorId:index, location scopes it to comment part and fingerprint.

public_api_mapping.name: MutateCommentsOptions
public_api_mapping.signature: { selection: SelectionQuery; id?: string; text?: string; author?: string; authorId?: string; initials?: string; timestamp?: string; left?: number; top?: number; all?: boolean; allowEmpty?: boolean }
public_api_mapping.ownership: Validated plain data options; explicit undefined omits a field, invalid/null fields rejected; no live owner transfer.
